title: Text2Dashboard：面向企业DataBrain的自然语言仪表盘生成治理型Agent架构
summary: Text2Dashboard是一个DataBrain专用原型，将自然语言分析请求转化为可审查的仪表盘。通过Codex插件与Agent Runtime，结合模式约束的模型决策、类型化工具、持久状态和确定性Hooks，实现审批、审计、检查点、恢复与故障处理。模型仅提出动作，确定性软件控制执行并记录状态转换。
summary_en: Text2Dashboard is a DataBrain-specific prototype that turns natural-language analytic requests into inspectable dashboards. An installable Codex plugin and standalone Agent Runtime combine schema-constrained model decisions with typed tools, persistent state, and deterministic Hooks for approval, audit, checkpointing, recovery, and failure handling. The model proposes actions while deterministic software controls execution and records state transitions.
